title: Lean the cone: shift the top of the spire
instruction: In build.mjs section 7, rebuild the top 4 courses of the cone (y>=24) one block toward -x/-z (NW) of centre so the spire visibly leans; keep finial fence (5,28,5) + lantern following the new apex. Re-run mcd check for orphans.

title: Bigger, better telescope
instruction: Replace the 3 lightning_rods with a thicker barrel: stripped_dark_oak_log axis x at (10,18,5),(11,18,5) plus lightning_rod facing east at (12,18,5); add a dark_oak_fence tripod x2 below at (10,17,5),(11,17,5).

title: Hanging sign for the tower name
where: front wall of shaft, x6 y8 z2 (above the door, below the slit window)
instruction: B.sign('dark_oak', ['THE CROOKED','SPIRE'], {facing:'north', color:'yellow', glow:true}) at (6,8,2); check there is stone at (6,8,3).

title: Second banner pair on west face
where: west wall of shaft x2, y8..9, z5 and z7
instruction: B.banner('cyan', [['circle','yellow'],['border','black']], {facing:'west'}) at (2,9,5) and (2,9,7) (same sun design as the front banners).

title: Lighter timber trim to cure dark-on-dark
where: floor-1 and floor-2 corner braces (dark_oak_stairs under the deck beams)
instruction: Change the knee-brace stairs in storey() from dark_oak to spruce stairs (put(x,yb,z,B.stairs('spruce',...))), and the window corner blocks from dark_oak_planks to spruce_planks, so braces read against the dark logs.

title: Flower boxes under floor-2 windows
where: front wall floor 2, x4..6 z0, y16; west wall z4..6 x0
instruction: Add dark_oak_slab type=top at (4..6,16,0) with potted_azure_bluet / potted_pink_tulip at y17 beside the glowing window (not in front of the window centre); mirror on the west wall at x0, z4..6.

title: Round the shaft corners
instruction: Replace each corner block with a stone_brick_stairs facing outward-diagonal pair (stairs shape outer_left/outer_right) at y3..10 to chamfer the corners; keep chiseled quoins every 3rd row on the neighbouring cells.

title: Smoke and cap on the chimney
where: chimney at x2 z7 above y25
instruction: Cap the chimney: replace the top stone_bricks block of the chimney at x2 z7 (below the campfire) with stone_brick_wall, and add 4 stone_brick_stairs (half top, facing outward) around it one block lower as a corbelled collar; keep the campfire on top.

title: Ivy up the timber jetties
instruction: Raise the vine base probability for y>10 from 0.1 to 0.25 in the ivy loop in build.mjs and add 'up' vines hanging under the balcony deck; re-run mcd check.

title: Mud-brick lintel over the door
instruction: Make the header y5 x5..7 stone bricks with a stair hood: set stone_brick_stairs facing north half top at (5,6,2),(6,6,2),(7,6,2) so the hood stands proud of the wall.
